question: Hitesh starts driving from Point A and drives 13 km towards the South. He turns right and drives 4 km, turns right again and drives 14 km. He turns right once more and drives 9 km. He turns right for the final time, drives 1 km, and stops at Point P. How far (minimum distance) and in which direction must he drive to reach back to Point A? (Unless specified otherwise, all turns are 90-degree turns.)
